items.title: fraction-heavy-score-treatment
items.claim: In Image #8, the stacked half beside HasanAbi’s 2 extends below the whole numeral in both the scoreboard and the large result score, making the score markedly taller than Asmongold’s 0.
items.reason: The player should read the outcome immediately; the oversized vertical fraction competes with the whole score instead of reading as its suffix.
items.suggest: Use a compact, deliberately aligned mixed-number treatment with a smaller stacked fraction, and give both score slots enough room to preserve a consistent visual center.

items.title: unexplained-reference-label
items.claim: In Images #2, #11, and #14, a small outlined label reading REFERENCE sits between the instructions and fighters without identifying what it refers to.
items.reason: It resembles an unfinished annotation or an unexplained control at the moment the player is deciding how to start.
items.suggest: If it opens instructions, label it TECHNIQUE GUIDE and make its button treatment unmistakable; if it is only a caption, replace it with a specific description or remove it.

items.title: detached-stick-mapping
items.claim: In Images #3 and #10, the directional action names appear in a separate two-column strip above the sticks, while the corresponding stick edges carry only chevrons.
items.reason: A newcomer must repeatedly translate between the legend and the thumb surface rather than recognize an action where they touch.
items.suggest: Place short action labels at the corresponding stick sectors, preserving an unobstructed thumb area, and move the longer combination explanations into the technique guide.

items.title: subdued-start-instructions
items.claim: In Image #2, the explanatory paragraph inside the dark introduction panel is visibly more subdued than the opponent heading and gold FIGHT button.
items.reason: The essential explanation of the two-stick grammar receives less visual emphasis than the invitation to start, making the first fight harder to understand at a glance.
items.suggest: Give the instruction paragraph a brighter solid text treatment and simplify it into two short lines that clearly distinguish stance from technique.

items.title: ambiguous-result-countdown
items.claim: In Images #8 and #18, the text STARTING IN 8 appears beneath REMATCH without naming what is starting.
items.reason: The result screen leaves the player uncertain whether the countdown refers to a rematch, another tournament round, or something else; a still cannot establish the actual behavior.
items.suggest: Name the destination explicitly, such as REMATCH STARTS IN 8, and make the button wording agree with it; verify the destination against a recording before choosing the final copy.
